paragraphs.text:
Perhaps you have been too cautious, but the results of the expedition 
have been disappointing so far. The morale of your party drops day 
by day. You will have to do something decisive soon.
Make a Persuade roll: if you succeed, go to 459; if you fail, go to 460.
